import collections

void topology(string[] names, (string, string)[] edges, bool show_cycle)
    ordered := names.sorted()
    n := #ordered
    graph := collections.directed_graph(ordered, edges)
    indegree := graph.indegrees()
    taken := array(n, fill = false)
    string[] result := []
    while true
        selected := n
        for: i < n
            if not taken[i] and indegree[i] == 0
                selected = i
                break
        if selected == n
            break
        taken[selected] = true
        .result.push(ordered[selected])
        for target := graph.outgoing(selected)[]
            indegree[target] -= 1
    println("order: {result.join(" -> ")}")
    if show_cycle
        remaining := [for i := ordered.indices()[] if not taken[i] then ordered[i]]
        println("cycle: {remaining.join(" ")}")

first := ["physics", "algebra", "graphics", "programming", "statistics", "calculus", "databases", "algorithms"]
first_edges := [
    ("calculus", "physics"), ("algebra", "calculus"), ("programming", "algorithms"),
    ("algebra", "statistics"), ("algorithms", "databases"), ("statistics", "databases"),
    ("calculus", "graphics"), ("algorithms", "graphics"), ("physics", "graphics"),
]
topology(first, first_edges, false)
second := ["music", "ecology", "art", "geology", "biology", "chemistry"]
second_edges := [
    ("music", "art"), ("art", "ecology"), ("biology", "chemistry"), ("chemistry", "ecology"),
    ("ecology", "geology"), ("geology", "chemistry"),
]
topology(second, second_edges, true)
